response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS avg_of_avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_of_avg_balance FROM (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id) AS t;

assumptions.assumption: The per-account average balance uses all of that account's transactions with amount > 2400, including those of type VYBER or with a missing type. Only the signed-amount figure excludes those types.

An account whose qualifying transactions are all VYBER or have a missing type has no signed amount. It is skipped for the first figure but still counted in the second. AVG ignores the NULL, which gives this behavior.
The 2400 threshold is applied to the unsigned stored amount.
